ThingDef.label: Apprentice Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Apprentice. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. Learn quickly and draw magicka back faster, at the cost of a weaker body.

ThingDef.label: Atronach Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Atronach. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. A much deeper well of magicka that refills more slowly.

ThingDef.label: Lady Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Lady. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. Wounds close faster and illness passes sooner.

ThingDef.label: Lord Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Lord. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. Hardens the skin against blades and blows.

ThingDef.label: Lover Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Lover. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. Everything goes a little easier: work, study, and talking to people.

ThingDef.label: Mage Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Mage. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. More magicka to work with, and faster study.

ThingDef.label: Ritual Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Ritual. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. A steadier mind. People under this stone rarely break.

ThingDef.label: Serpent Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Serpent. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. Quick hands in a fight, and poison doesn't bite as hard.

ThingDef.label: Shadow Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Shadow. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. Harder to pin down in melee, and quiet on the feet.

ThingDef.label: Steed Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Steed. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. Run faster and carry more.

ThingDef.label: Thief Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Thief. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. Light fingers and a better eye for a bargain.

ThingDef.label: Tower Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Tower. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. Sharper eyes and a mind for how things are built.

ThingDef.label: Warrior Stone
ThingDef.description: A standing stone carved with the sign of the Warrior. Anyone who lays a hand on it takes its blessing and gives up any other. Hits land more often, and pain doesn't slow you as much.
